location.repository: St. Catherine's Monastery of the Sinai

note.value: Mistakes in foliation from ff. 104-114, with attempted corrections: f. 107 originally numbered 106, consecutive folios were numbered and corrected accordingly
Quires numbered 1 to 14 by scribe in top right; quire 13 numbered twice, on ff. 97 and 99, here distinguished as quire 13a and quire 13b
Individual quires; quires 1-9 unsewn, quires 10-13a (ff. 73-98) barely attached, and quires 13b-14 (ff. 99-114) unsewn

bib.citation: Gardthausen, Victor E. Catalogus codicum Graecorum Sinaiticorum. Oxford, 1886
Kāmil, Murād. Catalogue of All Manuscripts in the Monastery of St. Catherine on Mount Sinai. Harrassowitz, 1970
Aland, Kurt. Kurzgefasste Liste der griechischen Handschriften des Neuen Testaments. Berlin: De Gruyter, 1963, rev. ed. 1994

program.label: Sinai Palimpsests Project
program.description: Imaged and studied as part of the Sinai Palimpsests Project (2011–2016), a collaboration between St. Catherine’s Monastery of the Sinai, the Early Manuscripts Electronic Library, and UCLA Library, funded by the Arcadia Fund and the Ahmanson Foundation. The project used multispectral imaging and scholarly analysis to recover and document erased and obscured texts in palimpsest manuscripts from the monastery’s collection.
